column1: # Exact repo-relative path<TAB>reviewed reason the file is safe to hot-sync.
# This is the authority; directory prefixes never grant permission. A live
# crontab/systemd reference can veto an entry at sync time, but silence from
# that refuter never adds a file. Adding a line is therefore a reviewed safety
# decision, not an inferred import-graph result.
